objective_summary: Requirements are requested and analyzed, and alternatives are evaluated.
Assets in scope are acquired in a controlled way and recorded.
Software the organization builds takes ITAM requirements into account.
Releases are planned and run in a way that supports ITAM.
Deployment and redeployment support ITAM requirements.
Day-to-day use, monitoring and optimization of assets support ITAM.
Assets leave use, and are repurposed, recycled or disposed of under policy, with records kept.
Planned changes are controlled and unplanned changes are reviewed.
Required data on every core asset is accurate through its life, with an authorized-or-not record.
License, entitlement and usage data is accurate, and reconciled and verified periodically.
Security, including access and integrity controls, is managed within ITAM and verified periodically.
Supplier and internal relationships and all contracts for assets in scope are managed.
Costs and values of assets are monitored and managed, including cost-effectiveness.
Service levels that ITAM depends on are defined, recorded and managed.
Risks not covered by another process are managed and the treatment is checked.
